Summary
I’m an Information Technology student with interests in software
development, backend engineering, and UI/UX design. I enjoy
building digital products that combine functionality, usability, and
meaningful user experiences. I have experience developing web and
mobile applications using technologies such as Express.js, React,
Flutter, PHP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Android Studio. I am also
familiar with RESTful APIs, database design, system integration,
and application development workflows. Alongside my technical
background, I have a strong interest in UI/UX and visual design.
Using tools such as Figma and Adobe Photoshop, I create usercentered interfaces that emphasize usability, consistency, and visual
clarity. My design experience helps me approach problem-solving
from both technical and user perspectives. I enjoy collaborating in
multidisciplinary teams, learning new technologies, and contributing
to projects that create meaningful digital experiences. I am
particularly interested in software engineering, product development,
and user-centered technology solutions. Let’s connect and build
impactful technology together.

As a Graphic Designer intern in the Public Relations Division at Universitas
Brawijaya, I was responsible for creating visual content for social media
